title: Moves set and clear Gmail's Important mark (real Gmail)
steps: With a real Gmail account and Settings › Importance & labels › Rules › Tell Gmail when I move mail on, pick a low-stakes conversation in Other that Gmail doesn't mark important and run Move to Important from ⌘K
Open the same conversation in Gmail on the web, then back in Mail run Move to Other on it and check Gmail on the web again
Leave both apps alone for at least 30 minutes, let Mail sync, then check the conversation in Gmail on the web and in the Gmail phone app
Note whether the phone notified you about the conversation after either move (with Gmail's High priority only notifications, if you use them)
expected: Step 1: the row leaves Other at once and Gmail shows the Important marker on every message of the conversation. Step 2: the marker is gone in Gmail and the row stays in Other. Step 3: Gmail has not put the mark back; if it has, note the time and whether a new message arrived. Step 4: record what the phone did; nothing in Mail claims Gmail learns from these moves.
